name: Ogiwara Kento
source: The story's protagonist. He's the son and sucessor of the local flower shop and is currently in training. He always admired Luna from afar as he could only see her from a far window. He never knew the bouquets he Ririela always buys from him is for Luna. After he's attacked by Luna when she ramoages due the lack of vital energy, he survives and after saving Luna, he transfers to Lilithtia School to support Luna in case she goes beserk again. His vital energy is very delicious to the succubi. His mother died when he was young so he doesn't have any memories of her.
